title: Modeled origin refreshes for one hot-key expiry
method: Synthetic 200 requests/s×0.5 s regeneration gives 100 arrivals in the miss window. Ten processes with local coalescing can produce 10 refreshes; a healthy shared claim targets 1. Assumes steady arrivals and no lease failure; not an exactly-once guarantee.
alt: Modeled origin refreshes for one hot-key expiry. No coalescing: 100 refresh attempts; 10 local single-flights: 10 refresh attempts; Shared single-flight: 1 refresh attempts. Illustrative values.
